Name:
Drake - Wu-Tang Forever (Remix)
(feat. Wu-Tang Clan; perf. U-God, Method Man, ???) (prod. 40)
Notes: After the release of the song "Wu-Tang Forever", Drake wanted to record a remix with the Clan on it. The group had six hours to record their verses whilst on tour in Europe. The most likely reason the track didn't come out is that the members' verses didn't go well with the concept of the song, with U-God saying that Drake was rapping about bitches whilst he was "rhymin' some hardcore shit". It's unknown how many Clan members recorded for the track; U-God confirmed in an interview that he and Method had recorded verses, whilst Ghost and Deck have said they didn't record for the song (Ghost also says that Drake wanted him and Raekwon to "go in" on the song, but since Ghost didn't record it's unclear if Rae did either). Meth has since stated in a 2025 interview that when the other members were writing to the track he said he "didn't like it", so it's unknown if he actually did record. In the U-God interview, he says that they had "all" recorded verses, so it can be assumed other members were on the track.
